description: The bar chart compares the accuracy percentages of two groups, MMAU and MMAR, across three different categories: Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni. The horizontal axis lists the categories, while the vertical axis, labeled 'Accuracy (%)', uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, with tick labels at intervals of 10 units. In the Qwen2-Audio-Instruct category, the MMAU bar is blue and reaches about 50% in height, while the MMAR bar is purple and is approximately 40% in height. In the Audio-Reasoner category, the MMAU bar is blue and reaches about 60%, and the MMAR bar is purple and is around 35%. In the Qwen-2.5-Omni category, the MMAU bar is blue and reaches about 65%, and the MMAR bar is purple and is close to 60%. The chart shows a consistent upward trend in MMAR performance across categories, with the gap between MMAU and MMAR narrowing significantly in the Qwen-2.5-Omni category. The legend on the top left of the chart indicates the colors of the bars corresponding to MMAU and MMAR.
